name: Abbies Acres Berry Farm

description: Abbies Acres Berry Farm is an agritourism farm in Sunnyside Road South, MN, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
